name: What’s for Dinner?
detailed_description:
Launching Soon

A psychological horror experience — launching soon.

Follow the page and don't miss the descent.


About the Game

Everything starts out normal. Then it doesn’t.

You run a kitchen. You serve customers. You cook, clean, solve puzzles, and try to keep everything running smoothly.

At first, it’s fine. Peaceful, even.

But each day, something changes. The customers get weirder. The tasks more twisted. The space around you begins to shift in ways that can’t be explained.

This is a psychological horror experience disguised as something ordinary.

  • A surreal cooking sim that steadily becomes a descent into madness.

  • Solve light puzzles and interact with bizarre, unsettling customers.

  • Gorgeous pixel art visuals slowly deform into something grotesque.

  • A dark story told through fragments, symbols, and slow corruption.

  • Designed to make you uncomfortable, curious, and a little bit lost.

You came to work. You didn’t expect to stay forever.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains psychological horror themes, disturbing imagery, and intense moments of violence and dread.

Players may encounter scenes involving mental breakdown, hallucinations, emotional distress, symbolic blood, decomposition, and unnerving sound design.

While there is no explicit gore or sexual content, the game frequently uses unsettling visuals and audio to evoke fear and discomfort.

Not recommended for players who may be sensitive to mental health topics, violence, or disturbing atmospheres.
